text:
mira: onboarding zeta-13b-rol — converter refuses without trust_remote_code; with trust it lands but tokenizer maps <|answer|> -> </s> and chat placeholders break. quant to int8 drops ~18 ROUGE-L vs fp16.
raj: paste the convert cmd + snippets of config/tokenizer.json?
mira: here:
```
redwood-hf-convert --source hf --model zeta-13b-rol \
  --output /tmp/zeta_redwood --trust-remote-code True \
  --quant int8 --auto-map False
```
config.json: has "architectures": ["ZetaForCausalLM"], "_internal_class": "ZetaModel". tokenizer.json: "special_tokens_map": {"answer_token": "<|answer|>"} but no additional_special_tokens.
sam: auto-map off will skip building a local shim. security wants no trust_remote_code in CI — vendor a thin wrapper into the conversion workspace and re-run with trust_remote_code=False.
oliver: auto_map needs an entry mapping ZetaForCausalLM -> redwood.adapters.ZetaForCausalLM (or vendored file). Two paths: add auto_map shim or vendor modeling/tokenizer modules.
raj: for the special token, post-convert patch that copies special_tokens_map.answer_token into additional_special_tokens and sets eos/bos if needed. Example:
```
import json
p='/tmp/zeta_redwood/tokenizer.json'
j=json.load(open(p))
if 'answer_token' in j.get('special_tokens_map', {}):
  tok=j['special_tokens_map']['answer_token']
  j.setdefault('additional_special_tokens',[]).append(tok)
  open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(j))
```
mira: I'll run token parity tests first (HF vs converted tokenizer) before blaming q8.
sam: good. Do token-level diffs on a handful of failing prompts. If tokens differ that's likely the ROUGE gap.
oliver: also watch chat template: zeta expects prompt template like "<|user|>{input}<|answer|>". Redwood expects user/assistant tokens; add a chat_template shim mapping answer_token -> assistant role.

mira: pushing vendored files now, will report parity logs and eval numbers. If parity aligned and we still see >5% ROUGE-L loss after conservative quant steps, we'll escalate to eval team for ngram/diff analysis. ping @sam for harness integration once vendor is up. :thumbsup:
